reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: p0995 and p0319 impose use/sourcing restrictions on MSL (the vendor/supplier), not on IBM, and restrictions binding the vendor are expressly acceptable under the rule's detection guidance.

p1491 (AECI) affirmatively preserves each party's freedom to provide or receive competitive products or services, reinforcing that no field-of-use, exclusivity or territory covenant binds IBM as Customer/Buyer.
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on the Customer remains.
Rationale appropriately notes the §9.0(f) non-solicit as a personnel covenant handled under a separate rule, avoiding double-flagging the same commercial term.
